blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Ultra-long video temporal grounding requires balancing long-range evidence search with fine-grained event understanding under a limited visual budget, yet existing agentic methods still rely largely on predefined policies and tool capabilities.
Motivated by this, we propose a novel policy–tool coevolution framework that jointly evolves high-level policies and executable media tools from the agentic reasoning trajectories of a VLM, forming a reusable skill without updating model parameters.
During evolution, an external skill updater distills transferable task experience in long-video temporal grounding, accordingly refining the orchestration of long-range image-based and fine-grained video-based observations.
Alongside these policy updates, the updater employs its coding capabilities to upgrade existing tools or create new ones, adapting the tools to long-video evidence acquisition.
Equipped with the evolved skill, the VLM autonomously orchestrates tools under the guidance of the evolved policy, coordinating image and video observations for agentic inference without relying on a separate, stronger planning model.
Extensive experiments spanning five benchmarks and three VLMs show that policy–tool coevolution consistently improves temporal grounding accuracy in ultra-long videos while reducing visual token cost at inference, and that the evolved skill yields substantial performance gains on general long-video QA without additional task-specific evolution, demonstrating the effectiveness and generalizability of our framework for long-video understanding.
blocks.zh:
超长视频时间定位需要在视觉预算有限的情况下平衡远程证据搜索和精细事件理解,然而现有的代理方法仍然在很大程度上依赖于预先定义的政策和工具能力.
以此为动力,我们提出了一个新的政策工具协同框架,共同从VLM的代理推理轨迹中演化出高级政策和可执行的媒体工具,形成可重复使用的技能,而不更新模型参数。
在演化过程中,一个外部技能更新器在长视频时间定位中提炼出可转移的任务经验,从而完善了长程图像和精细图像观测的管弦.
除了这些政策更新之外,更新者还利用其编码能力,更新现有工具或创建新的工具,使工具适应长视频证据的获取。
VLM在不断演变的政策指导下,在不依赖一个单独、更强有力的规划模式的情况下,以不断演变的技巧自主地协调各种工具,协调图像和视频观测,用于代理推论。
跨越5个基准和3个VLM的广泛实验表明,政策工具协同不断提高超长视频的时间定位精度,同时在推论中降低视觉符号成本,而演化后的技能在一般长视频QA上产生了显著的性能收益,而没有额外的特定任务演化,证明了我们长期视频理解框架的有效性和普遍性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Multimodal agents that support footage retrieval, clip extraction, and editing assistance must not only understand what happens in a video, but also translate users’ semantic intent into concrete segments on the timeline for subsequent operations ( Vidi Team et al., 2025 ) .
Video temporal grounding, which determines the time intervals of events described in natural language, is a fundamental capability bridging video understanding and downstream video operations ( Gao et al., 2017 ; Lei et al., 2021 ) .
However, as videos extend to tens of minutes or even hours, target events may occupy only a tiny fraction of the timeline, so accurate grounding requires both searching for relevant content across a vast temporal range and discerning event details, action changes, and temporal boundaries locally ( Soldan et al., 2022 ; Hannan et al., 2025 ; Seo and Kim, 2026 ) .
Under a limited visual budget, coarse observation may overlook brief events or key details, whereas repeated fine-grained inspection incurs high visual cost ( Buch et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2025 ) .
Balancing long-range evidence search with fine-grained event understanding is therefore a central challenge in ultra-long video temporal grounding.
blocks.zh:
支持镜头检索、剪辑提取和编辑援助的多式联运代理商不仅必须了解视频中发生的情况,还必须将用户的语义意图转化为后续操作时间表的具体部分(Vidi Team等人,2025年)。
视频时间定位决定了自然语言描述的事件的时间间隔,是连接视频理解和下游视频操作的基本能力(Gao等人,2017年;Lei等人,2021年).
然而,随着视频持续到数十分钟甚至数小时,目标事件可能只占据了时间线的一小部分,因此准确的地面定位既需要在广阔的时间范围内搜索相关内容,也需要在当地识别出事件细节,动作变化以及时间界限(Soldan等人,2022年;Hannan等人,2025年;Seo和Kim,2026年)。
根据有限的视觉预算,粗糙的观察可能忽略了短暂的事件或关键细节,而反复的精细检查则需要高昂的视觉成本(Buch等人,2025年;Hong等人,2025年)。
因此,平衡远程证据搜索和精细事件理解是超长视频时间定位的核心挑战。

blocks.en:
From an agentic perspective, ultra-long video temporal grounding can be organized as a process of actively acquiring, comparing, and verifying visual evidence through tool interactions, rather than a one-shot prediction on a fixed video input ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .
Conditioned on the query and accumulated observations, an agent can dynamically decide which time range to search next, which candidates to examine, and whether additional evidence is needed to confirm the event and its boundaries.
Existing studies have demonstrated the potential of multi-step search and tool use, yet the underlying observation mechanisms and media processing capabilities remain largely predefined ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
Tools are not merely interfaces for executing instructions; they also determine what visual input the model actually receives ( Hu et al., 2024 ) .
Beyond studying how an agent uses existing tools, it is therefore necessary to consider how the tools themselves should be designed to better support search and verification.
Moreover, evidence needs vary across videos and queries ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , making it difficult to predesign a general pipeline that balances grounding accuracy with visual cost.
This raises the central question of this work: how can task experience be leveraged to jointly improve a video agent’s tool capabilities and the policies guiding their use, so that grounding evidence can be acquired more accurately and efficiently?
blocks.zh:
从代理角度来说,超长视频时间定位可以组织为通过工具交互来积极获取,比较,验证视觉证据的过程,而不是固定视频输入的一拍预测(Liu等人,2026年).
根据查询和累积的观察,代理人可以动态地决定下一个搜索的时间范围,哪些候选人要检查,是否需要额外证据来确认事件及其界限.
现有的研究表明了多步骤搜索和使用工具的潜力,但基本的观测机制和媒体处理能力基本上仍然预先确定(Wang等人,2026年)。
工具不仅仅是执行指令的界面;它们也决定了模型实际收到的视觉输入(Hu等人,2024年).
因此,除了研究代理人如何利用现有工具外,还有必要考虑如何设计这些工具本身,以便更好地支持搜索和核查。
此外,证据需求因视频和询问而异(Wu等人,2024年),因此难以预先设计一个一般管道,以平衡地面精度和视觉成本。
这就提出了这项工作的中心问题:如何利用任务经验来共同提高视频代理工具的能力以及指导其使用的政策,从而能够更准确和更有效地获取基础证据?

blocks.en:
Our key insight is that tool-use policies and tool design are interdependent: high-level policies determine what evidence is needed, when to acquire it, and how to organize the search, while media tools determine the form and granularity of the evidence the tools can present to the model.
For example, comparing temporally distant candidates calls for image-based observations that compactly cover long temporal ranges while preserving their temporal correspondence, whereas judging action order, state changes, and event continuity may require local video-based observations ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2024 ) .
Effectively exploiting these complementary capabilities requires policies that select and orchestrate observations according to evidence needs, together with tools that support the corresponding sampling and presentation.
Refining policies alone may be limited by existing tool capabilities, while expanding tools alone does not necessarily enable an agent to make effective use of the new capabilities.
We therefore explore coevolving policies and tools from the same execution feedback, enabling mutual adaptation between observation capabilities and their orchestration.
Candidate omissions, boundary errors, and dynamic ambiguities exposed in execution trajectories can inform not only adjustments to search decisions but also improvements to media tools, thereby accumulating task experience in both policies and executable capabilities.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要见解是,工具使用政策和工具设计是相互依存的:高级别政策决定需要何种证据,何时获得,如何组织搜索,而媒体工具则决定工具可以向模型提供的证据的形式和颗粒性。
例如,比较时间上遥远的候选者需要基于图像的观察,这种观察在保持时间对应性的同时,会紧凑地涵盖较长的时间范围,而判断行动顺序、状态变化和事件连续性则可能需要基于当地视频的观察(Ye等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年;Li等人,2024年)。
有效开发这些互补能力需要根据证据需要选择和安排观测的政策,以及支持相应取样和列报的工具。
单靠完善政策可能受现有工具能力的限制,而单靠扩展工具不一定能使代理人有效利用新能力。
因此,我们探索从同样的执行反馈中形成共同的政策和工具,使观察能力及其协调性能够相互适应。
候选的遗漏、边界错误和执行轨迹中暴露的动态模糊性不仅有助于调整搜索决定,而且有助于改进媒体工具,从而积累政策和可执行能力方面的任务经验。

blocks.en:
Building upon these insights, we propose CoEvoWhen, a policy–tool coevolution framework for ultra-long video temporal grounding.
The framework jointly represents high-level policies and executable media tools as a reusable external skill, and iteratively improves it from task experience without updating the parameters of the vision-language model (VLM).
Starting from a minimal base skill that provides only the basic grounding protocol, initial observation instructions, and primitive image and video observation operations, the VLM executes grounding tasks to generate trajectories, which are paired with the corresponding ground-truth temporal intervals to form task feedback.
An external skill updater then distills transferable experience from this feedback, refining policies for task planning and observation orchestration while synthesizing code to modify existing media tools or create new ones, so that improvements extend beyond prompts and invocation sequences to the actual evidence sampling and presentation capabilities.
The evolved skill supports image-based search, candidate refinement, and selective video verification.
At inference, the VLM autonomously invokes tools from the fixed skill based on the query and accumulated evidence, without relying on a separate, stronger planning model.
blocks.zh:
基于这些见解,我们提议CEEvo When,一个用于超长视频时间定位的政策工具协同框架。
该框架作为可重复使用的外部技能,共同代表高级别政策和可执行的媒体工具,并根据任务经验反复加以改进,而不更新视觉语言模型(VLM)的参数。
VLM从仅提供基础地基协议,初步观测指令,以及原始图像和视频观测操作的最低限度基础技能开始,执行地基任务生成轨迹,这些轨迹与相应的地面-真实时间间隔配对,形成任务反馈.
然后,一个外部技能更新器从这些反馈中提炼出可转移的经验,完善任务规划和观察组织化的政策,同时合成代码,以修改现有的媒体工具或创建新的工具,从而使改进范围从提示和引用序列延伸到实际的证据取样和展示能力。
演化后的技能支持基于图像的搜索,候选人的完善,以及选择性的视频验证.
推论,VLM自主地从基于查询和累积证据的固定技能中引用工具,而不依赖于单独的,更强大的规划模式.

blocks.en:
We conduct systematic evaluations on three ultra-long video temporal grounding benchmarks and two long-video question answering (QA) benchmarks.
The results demonstrate that coevolution improves grounding accuracy while simultaneously reducing visual token cost.
Notably, on ExtremeWhenBench ( Seo and Kim, 2026 ) , evolving the base skill for Qwen3.5-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) raises mIoU by 74.9% , while reducing the average cumulative visual token cost by 11.4% .
Consistent gains are also observed when skills are evolved separately on different VLMs. Moreover, applying the evolved grounding skill directly to long-video QA improves performance without additional task-specific evolution, demonstrating the cross-task reusability of the accumulated experience.
Ablation studies further show that coevolution attains a better combination of accuracy and visual cost than evolving either policies or tools alone, supporting the rationale for jointly adapting observation capabilities and their usage policies.
blocks.zh:
我们对三个超长视频时间定位基准和两个长视频问题回答基准进行系统评价。
结果显示,共进会提高了定位精度,同时降低了视觉符号成本。
值得注意的是,在ExtremeWhen Bench(徐和金,2026年)上,Quen3.5-27B(Quen Team,2026a)的基础技能不断演变,使mIoU提高了74.9%,同时将平均累计视觉符号成本降低了11.4%。
当技能在不同自愿工序上分别发展时,也观察到持续的进展。 此外,将演化的地面技能直接应用于长视频QA可以提高性能,而无需额外的特定任务演化,表明累积经验的跨任务重复性.
校准研究进一步表明,校准比仅制定政策或工具更能兼顾准确性和视觉成本,支持联合调整观测能力及其使用政策的理由。

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are as follows: 1) We propose CoEvoWhen, which jointly evolves high-level policies and executable media tools from a VLM’s execution trajectories, distilling ultra-long video grounding experience into a reusable external skill without updating model parameters. 2) We evolve the orchestration of complementary image-based and video-based observations, enabling the VLM to acquire evidence autonomously without manually predefined coordination strategies or a stronger external planner. 3) We conduct systematic experiments across five benchmarks and three VLMs, complemented by policy–tool and image–video ablations, substantiating the effectiveness and generalizability of our framework, as well as the transferability of the evolved skill to general long-video understanding.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的主要贡献如下: 1) 我们提议ECEvo When,它共同将高级政策和可执行的媒体工具从VLM的执行轨迹中演化出来,将超长视频地面经验提炼成可重复使用的外部技能,而不更新模型参数。 2)我们发展了基于图像和视频的补充观测的编组,使甚高频能够自主地获取证据,而无需手动预先确定的协调战略或更强大的外部规划者. 3) 我们通过五个基准和三个甚高频进行系统实验,辅之以政策工具和图像录像,证实我们框架的有效性和普遍性,以及将不断发展的技能转移到一般的长期录像理解。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Long-Video Temporal Grounding
blocks.zh: 2.1 长视时间定位

blocks.en:
Video temporal grounding aims to identify temporal intervals corresponding to natural language queries in untrimmed videos ( Mu et al., 2024 ) .
Early methods typically rely on precomputed video features to predict these intervals in a single pass ( Zhang et al., 2020 ; Moon et al., 2023 ) .
VTimeLLM ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , TimeChat ( Ren et al., 2024 ) , and UniTime ( Li et al., 2025 ) further enhance the temporal awareness of generative multimodal models through grounding-specific adaptation, enabling direct generation of query-relevant timestamps or intervals.
As video duration grows to tens of minutes or even several hours, CONE ( Hou et al., 2023 ) , SOONet ( Pan et al., 2023 ) , and ReVisionLLM ( Hannan et al., 2025 ) narrow the temporal search space through query-guided window selection, single-pass scanning, and recursive refinement, respectively.
More flexible agentic frameworks acquire query-relevant visual evidence dynamically: VideoAgent ( Wang et al., 2025c ) employs an LLM agent to iteratively identify relevant visual information, VideoTree ( Wang et al., 2025d ) constructs a query-adaptive hierarchical video representation, and DVD ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) uses an LLM to plan and orchestrate visual tools.
Although these frameworks advance evidence acquisition from one-shot prediction to multi-step search and tool use, their underlying media processing capabilities remain largely predefined.
We instead use the VLM’s temporal grounding trajectories to jointly evolve media tools and the coordination of image-based and video-based observations, enabling more accurate and efficient grounding in ultra-long videos.
blocks.zh:
视频时间定位旨在识别未剪辑视频中与自然语言询问相对应的时间间隔(Mu等人,2024年).
早期的方法一般依靠预先计算的视频功能来预测这些间隔在一个单传(张等人,2020年;月球等人,2023年).
时间LLM (黄等人,2024年),时间. Chat(Ren等人,2024年)和UniTime(Li等人,2025年)通过地面特异性改造,进一步提高了基因多模式模式的时间意识,从而能够直接生成与查询相关的时间戳或间隔.
随着视频持续时间增长到数十分钟甚至数小时,CONE(Hou等人,2023年),SOONet(Pan等人,2023年),ReVisionLLM(Hannan等人,2025年)分别通过查询引导窗口选择,单路扫描和递归改进,缩小了时间搜索空间.
更灵活的代理框架动态地获取与查询相关的视觉证据:VideoAgent(Wang等人,2025c)使用LLM代理来迭代识别相关的视觉信息,VideoTree(Wang等人,2025d)构建一个可查询适应的分级视频表现,DVD(Zhang等人,2025b)使用LLM来规划和指挥视觉工具.
虽然这些框架将证据的获取从一拍预测推进到多步骤的搜索和工具使用,但其基本的媒体处理能力在很大程度上仍然是预先确定的。
我们利用VLM的时空定位轨迹,共同发展媒体工具,协调基于图像和视频的观测,从而在超长视频中更准确和高效地定位。

blocks.en: 2.2 Self-Evolving Agent Skills
blocks.zh: 2.2 自我发展代理技能

blocks.en:
Self-evolving skill frameworks turn execution trajectories and interaction feedback into reusable policies, programs, or tools, allowing task experience to accumulate without updating model parameters ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
For task planning and tool use, ExpeL ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) distills execution experience into reusable natural language guidance, while XSkill ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) organizes multimodal experience into task-level skills.
Experience can also be retained in executable form, with Voyager ( Wang et al., 2023 ) accumulating successful programs as reusable code skills for retrieval and composition across tasks.
These approaches advance experience reuse, but do not explicitly couple high-level policy refinement with updates to underlying tool implementations.
Although SkillSmith ( Wei et al., 2026 ) adapts both skills and tools, it restricts tool updates to predefined operations on the existing tool library.
For long-video understanding, META ( Huang et al., 2026 ) abstracts tool trajectories into reusable macro-tools and refines tool-specific usage constraints, but leaves the task-level orchestrator outside the evolution loop.
In contrast, our framework jointly evolves high-level policies and executable media tools, adapting visual sampling and presentation alongside observation orchestration to yield a reusable skill that the frozen VLM executes autonomously without relying on a stronger external planner.
blocks.zh:
自演技能框架将执行轨迹和互动反馈转化为可重复使用的政策、程序或工具,使任务经验得以积累而无需更新模型参数(Shinn等人,2023年;Wang等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2025年a;Zhang等人,2026年a).
对于任务规划和工具使用,ExpeL(赵等人,2024年)将执行经验提炼成可重复使用的自然语言指导,而XSkill(江等人,2026年)则将多式联运经验组织成任务级技能.
经验也可以以可执行的形式保留,Voyager(Wang等人,2023年)积累成功的程序作为跨任务检索和构成的可重复使用的代码技能.
这些办法促进了经验的再利用,但没有明确将高级别政策的改进与对基本工具执行的更新结合起来。
虽然SkillSmith(Wei et al., 2026)既适应技能和工具,又限制工具更新,以预设现有工具库上的操作.
对于长视频理解,META(Huang等人,2026年)摘要工具轨迹成为可重复使用的宏工具,并完善了工具特有的使用限制,但任务级的管弦乐器留在进化循环之外.
相比之下,我们的框架共同发展了高层次的政策和可执行的媒体工具,调整了视觉采样和展示,同时调整了观察的条理,以产生一种可重复使用的技能,而冻结的VLM在不依赖更强大的外部规划人员的情况下自主地加以执行。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Benchmarks, baselines, and metrics. We evaluate ultra-long video temporal grounding on three benchmarks.
VUE-LVTR comprises visual queries from VUE-TR ( Vidi Team et al., 2025 ) and VUE-TR-V2 ( Vidi Team et al., 2026 ) restricted to videos of at least 30 minutes.
Videos in ExtremeWhenBench ( Seo and Kim, 2026 ) average approximately 76 minutes, while the evaluation on CoMET-Bench ( Zou et al., 2026 ) covers multi-event grounding in videos of at least 30 minutes.
We select 100 challenging VUE-LVTR queries from distinct videos for evolution and evaluate the same evolved skill on the three benchmarks.
Results on VUE-LVTR are reported on the disjoint held-out set.
We also assess long-video QA transfer on LVBench ( Wang et al., 2025a ) and LSDBench ( Qu et al., 2025 ) .
For baselines, we primarily compare the base and evolved skills under identical task protocols and inference settings, while also including other VLM-based and agent-based methods.
These comparisons cover the open-source VLMs Qwen3.5-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) , InternVL3.5-8B ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , and TimeLens-7B ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , as well as the closed-source VLMs Gemini 2.5 Flash ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) and GPT-5.6 Luna ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , with VideoMind-7B ( Liu et al., 2026 ) and EvoGround-7B ( Jung et al., 2026 ) serving as agent-based baselines.
Performance on all five benchmarks is measured using their official metrics, and for efficiency, we compute cumulative visual token cost by summing visual tokens received by the VLM across rounds and averaging over queries, with separate image and video costs.
Counts of model calls, local tool calls, and visual observations characterize interaction overhead.
Detailed baseline evaluation protocols and metric definitions are provided in Appendix B.2 .

Evolution and inference. We evolve the skill on Qwen3.5-27B with Codex (GPT-5.5, xhigh) as the external skill updater ( OpenAI, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2026a ) .
The base skill’s policy specifies only the basic grounding protocol, without predefined task planning or observation coordination, while its tool set supports only basic image and video observations, media probing, frame extraction, and clip extraction.

We make one pass over the evolution set, keeping VLM weights frozen throughout.
During policy-guided agentic inference, we incorporate the evolved policy into the VLM’s system prompt and register the skill’s tools as callable functions for multi-turn reasoning.
Both skills are evaluated with thinking enabled and greedy decoding, using at most 24 inference rounds per query.

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 1 , the evolved skill achieves the best results on all reported metrics, surpassing seven VLM-based and agent-based baselines.
Relative to the base skill, IoU AUC rises from 0.4107 to 0.5137 on the VUE-LVTR held-out set.
For ExtremeWhenBench, evolution further improves mIoU and Recall@0.5 by 74.9% and 88.4% , respectively, suggesting that the evolved skill supports effective evidence search in hour-long videos and generalizes beyond the evolution data.
Results on CoMET-Bench show gains of 0.0280 in mIoU and 10.93 points in Rejection-F1, indicating that the coevolved observation capabilities help the frozen VLM acquire, verify, and select evidence across multi-event and target-absent queries.
Together, these gains indicate that policy–tool coevolution distills temporal grounding experience into a transferable skill for acquiring long-video evidence more accurately without updating model parameters.
blocks.zh:
如表1所示,不断演变的技能在所有报告的指标上都取得了最佳结果,超过了7个基于VLM和基于剂的基线。
相对于基础技能,IoU AUC在VUE-LVTR的牵引装置上从0.4107升至0.5137.
对于Extreme When Bench,进化进一步将mIoU和Recall@0.5分别提高74.9%和88.4%,说明进化后的技能支持在长达小时的视频中进行有效的证据搜索,并概括到进化数据之外.
CoMET-Bench的结果显示mIoU的得分为0.0280分,Retion-F1的得分为10.93分,这表明共同演化的观测能力帮助被冻结的VLM获得,核实,并选择跨多事件和目标未实现的询问的证据.
这些成果共同表明,政策工具共同演变将时间基础经验提炼成一种可转移的技能,在不更新模型参数的情况下更准确地获取长视频证据。

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Inference Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 推论效率

blocks.en:
Table 2 illustrates the improvements in inference efficiency achieved through policy–tool coevolution.
Average visual tokens per query drop from 202.6k to 141.9k ( 30.0% fewer) on the VUE-LVTR held-out set, with reductions of 11.4% on ExtremeWhenBench and 18.9% on CoMET-Bench.
Model calls also decrease across all three benchmarks, suggesting that the VLM equipped with the evolved skill makes more efficient and targeted decisions about how to observe ultra-long videos.
A closer examination of the ExtremeWhenBench results reveals that tokens for image-based observations increase from 179.3k to 197.5k, whereas those for video-based observations fall from 47.8k to 3.7k, reflecting the reallocation of the visual budget during coevolution.
blocks.zh:
表2说明了通过政策工具协同实现的推论效率的提高。
在VUE-LVTR被搁置的套装上,每个查询的平均视觉信号从202.6k下降到141.9k(减少30.0%),在ExtremeWhen Bench上减少11.4%,在Comet-Bench上减少18.9%。
模型调用在所有三个基准中也都有所下降,这表明装备了进化技能的VLM使得关于如何观察超长视频的决定更有效和更有针对性的.
对Extreme When Bench结果的更仔细审查表明,基于图像的观测信号从179.3k增加到197.5k,而基于视频的观测信号则从47.8k降到3.7k,反映了在共演过程中视觉预算的重新分配。

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Cross-VLM Generalization and Cross-Task Transfer
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 跨VLM 通用和跨任务转让

blocks.en:
For different VLM backbones, as summarized in Table 4 , policy–tool coevolution improves ExtremeWhenBench mIoU by 99.2% and 24.7% on Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) and Qwen3.6-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) , respectively, which supports the framework’s cross-VLM generalizability.
In addition, when the evolved skill is applied directly to general long-video QA, Qwen3.5-27B ’s overall accuracy on LVBench and LSDBench improves by 8.65 and 7.98 points, respectively, demonstrating that the coevolved policies and tools can transfer effectively to broader long-video understanding scenarios.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablations and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 分析和分析

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Ablation on Policy–Tool Coevolution
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 政策-工具化演变

blocks.en:
To assess the benefit of policy–tool coevolution and each component’s contribution, we compare policy-only and tool-only variants that freeze the tools and policies during evolution, respectively.
Both use the same evolution set, evolution configuration, and VUE-LVTR held-out evaluation protocol as the full method.
As shown in Figure 4 , both variants improve grounding accuracy over the base skill, confirming policies and tools as effective evolution targets.
Joint evolution achieves the best accuracy–cost combination, exceeding policy-only and tool-only by 0.0243 and 0.0735 in IoU AUC while reducing visual token cost by 40.6% and 25.5% , respectively.
This reveals that more efficient evidence acquisition from ultra-long videos relies on both executable media tools to expand the available observation capabilities and high-level policies to select and orchestrate them.
In particular, freezing the policies during evolution leads to a larger accuracy loss than freezing the tools, suggesting that stronger observation capabilities can yield substantial gains in ultra-long video temporal grounding when strategically organized into an efficient and accurate evidence search process.
blocks.zh:
为了评估政策工具的共进和每个组成部分的贡献的好处,我们比较了在进化过程中分别冻结工具和政策的只有政策和只有工具的变体。
两者都使用相同的演化集,演化配置,以及VUE-LVTR所持有的评价协议作为全方法.
如图4所示,两种变式都提高了基础技能的定位准确性,确认政策和工具是有效的演变目标。
联合进化实现最佳的准确性—成本组合,在IoU AUC中,仅政策成本和工具成本分别超过0.0243和0.0735,同时将视觉符号成本分别降低40.6%和25.5%.
这表明,从超长视频获取证据的效率更高,既依靠可执行的媒体工具来扩大现有的观测能力,也依靠高层政策来选择和安排。
特别是,在演化过程中冻结政策会导致比冻结工具更大的准确性损失,这表明,如果从战略上组织成一个高效和准确的证据搜索过程,加强观测能力可以在超长视频时间定位方面取得巨大收益。

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Ablation on Image–Video Coordination
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 图像-视频协调

blocks.en:
We further conduct image-only and video-only ablations, each restricting the skill’s observations to a single modality during evolution and evaluation, to isolate each modality’s contribution and assess coordinated image–video observation.
As shown in Table 4 , both single-modality variants improve grounding performance through evolution, and image–video coordination yields further benefits: the evolved image+video skill outperforms both single-modality skills across all grounding metrics while using fewer visual tokens.
These empirical results underscore that image-based and video-based observations are suited to different contexts in ultra-long video temporal grounding, and that strategically coordinating the two makes better use of their complementary strengths, achieving accuracy gains and cost reductions in tandem.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步进行只有图像和视频的模拟,在演化和评价期间,每个都把技能的观察限制在一个单一模式,以孤立每个模式的贡献和评估协调一致的图像-视频观察。
如表4所示,单一模式变体通过演化提高地面性能,图像-视频协调产生进一步的好处:演化的图像+视频技能在所有地面测量中都优于单一模式技能,同时使用较少的视觉标志。
这些经验性结果突出表明,基于图像和视频的观测在超长视频时间定位中适合不同背景,在战略上协调两者能更好地利用互补优势,同时实现准确性收益和成本降低.

blocks.en: 4.3.3 Analysis of Skill Evolution
blocks.zh: 4.3.3 技能演变分析

blocks.en:
Figure 5 illustrates online performance–cost dynamics during skill evolution.
As evolution proceeds, the skill achieves higher grounding accuracy with lower visual token cost more consistently.
Figure 5 further shows how candidate omissions, boundary errors, and dynamic ambiguities exposed in trajectories drive coordinated adjustments to observation capabilities and their orchestration: image-based tools with candidate-retention and local-refinement policies improve evidence coverage and boundary judgment, while video-based observation targets action verification, order discrimination, and continuity assessment.
Together, these advances suggest that policy–tool coevolution distills execution feedback into mutually adapted observation capabilities and policies, letting the VLM allocate its visual budget according to evidence needs for more accurate yet cheaper grounding.
Qualitative case studies are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh:
图5显示了技能演变过程中的在线业绩-成本动态。
随着进化过程的进行,这种技能实现了更高的定位精度,视觉符号成本更低。
图5还显示,在轨迹中暴露的候选疏漏、边界错误和动态模糊性如何促使对观测能力及其协调性作出协调一致的调整:以图像为基础的工具与候选保留和地方精减政策一起改进证据覆盖面和边界判断,而以视频为基础的观测则针对行动核查、命令歧视和连续性评估。
这些进步合在一起表明,政策工具共同演变将执行反馈分解为相互适应的观察能力和政策,让VLM根据证据需要分配其视觉预算,以便更准确、更便宜地扎地。
定性案例研究见附录D。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We propose CoEvoWhen, a policy–tool coevolution framework that jointly evolves high-level policies and executable media tools from agentic reasoning trajectories into a reusable external skill for ultra-long video temporal grounding.
Equipped with the evolved skill, the VLM autonomously orchestrates tools under policy guidance, coordinating image-based and video-based observations without relying on a stronger external planner.
Comprehensive experiments show that policy–tool coevolution improves grounding accuracy while reducing visual token cost, with gains generalizing across VLMs and transferring to long-video QA without further task-specific evolution.
We believe that coevolving what a VLM can observe with how it decides to observe offers a promising path toward seeing less yet understanding more in ultra-long videos.
blocks.zh:
我们提议Echovo When, 一个政策工具联合演进框架,
VLM在政策指导下自主地协调各种工具,在不依赖更强大的外部规划者的情况下,以图像和视频为基础协调观测。
全面的实验表明,政策工具协同可以提高定位准确性,同时降低视觉符号成本,收益可以泛指VLM,并转移到长视频QA而无需进一步针对具体任务进行演变。
我们认为,虚拟LM如何决定观察,可以共同观察什么,这为在超长视频中看到更多的了解提供了一条大有希望的道路。

blocks.en: B.1.1 Evolution Set Construction

blocks.en: We select 100 queries from the purely visual temporal retrieval instances of VUE-TR-V2 ( Vidi Team et al., 2026 ) to form the evolution set. Candidate instances are required to have an available source video of at least 30 minutes, spanning both long and ultra-long (at least 60 minutes) videos.

blocks.en: Selection jointly considers video duration, the number and length of target intervals, target sparsity, and whether the query involves action order, visual detail, or compound conditions. Table 5 summarizes the main characteristics of the evolution set. Among these queries, 80 have sparse target events and 88 contain at least one target interval no longer than 10 seconds. Together, these instances allow the limited set of execution trajectories to cover observation needs ranging from long-range search to short-event localization and multi-candidate handling.

blocks.en: B.1.2 Base Skill
blocks.zh: B.1.2 基础技能

blocks.en: The base skill 𝒮 ( 0 ) \mathcal{S}^{(0)} comprises policy documents, tool descriptions and interfaces, and the source code of the local media tools. The policies are organized into SKILL.md and three supporting documents: policy-notes.md carries guidance for task planning, tool-selection.md specifies how tools and observation modes are selected, and tool-notes.md records the input–output semantics and usage notes of each tool. Within this structure, the initial policies specify only a basic grounding protocol and elementary descriptions of the observation modes, without prescribing sophisticated strategies for global search, candidate management, or orchestration across modalities.

blocks.en: The base and evolved skills remain fixed throughout evaluation. For a given VLM, both use the same set of queries, task prompts, decoding configuration, interaction budget, and scorer. blocks.en: B.2.4 Baseline Evaluation Protocols
blocks.zh: B.2.4 基线评价议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate seven VLM-based and agent-based baselines on the three ultra-long video temporal grounding benchmarks. Among open-source VLMs, Qwen3.5-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) receives video input with 768 frames uniformly sampled across the full duration, InternVL3.5-8B ( Wang et al., 2025b ) uses a 128-frame image sequence, and TimeLens-7B ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) uses 384 video frames with textual timestamps. For the closed-source models Gemini 2.5 Flash ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) and GPT-5.6 Luna ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , the input consists of 128 uniformly sampled frames arranged chronologically in timestamped image grids. Agent-based baselines include VideoMind-7B ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , in which grounding and verification roles collaborate for multi-step video reasoning, and EvoGround-7B ( Jung et al., 2026 ) , which uses feedback between its Proposer and Solver for self-evolving training to improve temporal grounding.
blocks.zh: 我们根据三个超长视频时间定位基准评估7个基于甚高分辨率和基于剂的基线。 在开源VLM中,Quen3.5-27B (Quen Team, 2026a )接收视频输入,全程统一采样768帧,InternVL3.5-8B(Wang等人,2025b)使用128帧图像序列,TimeLens-7B(Zhang等人, 2026b)使用384个带文字时间戳的视频帧. 对于闭源模型双子座2.5 Flash(Comanici等人,2025年)和GPT-5.6 Luna(OpenAI,2026b),输入由128个按时间标注的图像网格按时间顺序排列的统一取样帧组成. 基于代理的基线包括VideoMind-7B(Liu等人,2026年),其中地面与核查角色合作进行多步骤的视频推理;以及EvoGround-7B(Jung等人,2026年),其投标人与Solver之间的反馈用于自我演化培训,以改善时间地面.

blocks.en: We analyze the execution trajectories of the base and evolved skills on two ExtremeWhenBench ( Seo and Kim, 2026 ) queries using the same Qwen3.5-27B. Figures 6 and 7 illustrate how policy–tool coevolution changes evidence acquisition for localizing an action and a scene, respectively. Both skills remain fixed during evaluation, and visual token costs are computed following the definitions in Appendix B.2.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们用相同的Quen3.5-27B来分析基地的行刑轨迹, 图6和图7分别说明了政策工具联合如何改变获取证据,使行动和场景本地化。 这两种技能在评价期间保持不变,视标成本按照附录B.2.2中的定义计算。

blocks.en: In Figure 6 , the query asks when fries are scooped with a metal skimmer into a holding trough in a 50.6-minute video. The base skill selects a candidate near 900 s from 15 sparse frames and inspects four overlapping clips in this region. Although the initial clips do not confirm the queried action, the model continues to inspect the same region and ultimately mistakes a chute transfer for the requested action. In contrast, the evolved skill uses timestamped contact sheets for global comparison, followed by dense frame inspection over 550–590 s and a single 15-second clip for verification. The prediction matches the ground-truth interval [ 570,582 ] [570,582] s, raising IoU from 0 to 1. Meanwhile, video tokens drop from 168.98k to 11.88k, leading to a 51.27% net reduction in visual token cost. This trajectory illustrates how better candidate localization allows video observation to focus on verifying query-specific motion, reducing repeated inspection of an incorrect region.
blocks.zh: 在图6中, 询问薯条何时被用金属滑板挤进50.6分钟的视频中, 基础技能从15个稀疏的框框中挑选了一名近900s的候选人,并检查了该区域四个重叠的片段. 虽然最初的剪辑没有证实被询问的动作,但该模型继续检查同一区域,并最终错误地为所请求的动作传送槽. 与此形成对照的是,不断演变的技能使用加时标的接触表进行全球比较,然后是550-590 s 的密集帧检查和15秒的单片检查。 预测与地面真实间隔相匹配 [570,582] [570,582] s,将IoU从0提高到1. 同时,视频信使从168.98k下降到11.88k,导致视频信使成本净下降51.27%. 这一轨迹说明,如何更好地将候选人本地化,使得视频观察能够侧重于核查特定查询动议,从而减少对不正确的区域的反复检查。

blocks.en: Figure 7 concerns an 11-second scene of a couple walking along a tree-lined path in golden light within a 100.1-minute video. The base skill performs six batches of sparse sampling across the long timeline but misses the brief target scene. Subsequent frame and video inspection focuses on a visually similar candidate, yielding the incorrect interval [ 1868 , 1915 ] [1868,1915] s. The evolved skill instead packs 192 frames into eight contact sheets, allowing a broad search within one image observation. After identifying a candidate near 5708 s, it uses a local contact sheet over 5680–5740 s and targeted boundary frames to determine when the scene begins and ends. These image-based observations localize the target to [ 5703 , 5714 ] [5703,5714] s without video observation, increasing IoU from 0 to 1 while reducing visual token cost by 45.78% . This case highlights the importance of discovering a brief target during global search before investing in local boundary refinement.
blocks.zh: 图7显示一对夫妇在100.1分钟的视频中, 基础技术在很长的时间内进行了六批零星取样,但错过了简短的目标场景。 随后的帧和视频检查侧重于一个视觉上相似的候选人,产生错误的间隔[1868,1915] [1868,1915] s. 演化后的技能将192帧打包成8个接触表,允许在一个图像观测范围内进行广泛的搜索. 在确定5708s附近的候选人后,它使用超过5680-5740s的局部接触表和有针对性的边界框来确定场景何时开始和结束. 这些基于图像的观测将目标本地化到[5703,5714][5703,5714]s没有视频观测,将IoU从0增加到1,同时将视觉符号成本降低45.78%. 这一案例凸显了在全球搜索过程中发现一个简短目标,然后投资完善当地边界的重要性。

blocks.en: Together, these two cases illustrate the connection between tool capabilities and observation orchestration: the evolved tools provide compact temporal coverage and explicit temporal correspondence, while the policies organize subsequent observations around the evidence still needed. In the base trajectories, the additional local evidence gathered remains confined to an incorrect candidate. The evolved trajectories instead improve candidate localization before resolving the remaining temporal uncertainty, using video to verify action progression in one case and images to determine scene boundaries in the other. This contrast illustrates how coordinated image–video observation adapts to the evidence needs of different queries. By coupling the form in which evidence is presented with decisions about where to search and what to verify, the evolved skill enables the VLM to achieve more precise grounding at a lower visual token cost.
blocks.zh: 这两个案例一起说明了工具能力和观测协调之间的联系:演化后的工具提供了紧凑的时间覆盖面和明确的时间通信,而政策则围绕仍然需要的证据组织随后的观察。 在基本轨迹中,所收集的额外当地证据仍限于一个不正确的候选人。 演化的轨迹在解决剩余时间不确定性之前,改进了候选方的本地化,使用视频验证一个案例中的动作进展,图像测定另一个案例中的场景边界. 这一对比表明协调的图像-视频观察如何适应不同查询的证据需要。 通过将提交证据的形式与关于何处搜索和核实什么的决定相结合,不断发展的技能使VLM能够以较低的视觉符号成本实现更精确的地基定位.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Candidate localization and motion verification. The base skill repeatedly inspects an incorrect candidate, whereas the evolved skill combines global contact-sheet search with local frame inspection and a single short video to verify the complete action, precisely localizing the target interval while reducing visual token cost by 51.27% .
blocks.zh: 图6:候选人本地化和运动核查。 基础技能反复检查一个不正确的候选人,而进化后的技能结合了全局接触表搜索和本地帧检查,以及一个单一的短视频来验证完整的动作,精确地将目标间隔本地化,同时将视觉符号成本降低51.27%.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Long-range search and boundary refinement. Sparse sampling misses the brief target, leading the base skill to mistakenly focus on a visually similar scene. The evolved skill instead combines global and local contact sheets with boundary frames to precisely localize the target interval, reducing visual token cost by 45.78% .
blocks.zh: 图7:远程搜索和边界完善. Sparse采样错过了短暂的目标,导致基础技能错误地聚焦于视觉相似的场景. 演化后的技能将全球和局部接触表与边界框结合,精确地将目标间隔定位,将视觉符号成本降低45.78%.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: At present, our policy–tool coevolution is conducted on a limited set of temporal grounding queries from a single data source with labeled feedback. Although the evolved skill improves performance across ultra-long video temporal grounding and long-video QA tasks, broader data sources, larger evolution scales, and evolution without labeled feedback remain to be further explored. All visual observations in the current framework are performed directly by the VLM acting as the main agent. A meaningful next step is to extend coevolution to determine when the main agent should observe directly or delegate observation to subagents, and how they can coordinate efficiently. Since we currently focus only on the visual modality, extending the framework to more general omni-modal settings also merits investigation.
blocks.zh: 目前,我们的政策工具组合是在有限的一系列时间基础上进行的,这些查询来自单一的数据来源,并附有标签的反馈。 虽然演化后的技能提高了超长视频时空定位和长视频QA任务的性能,但更广泛的数据来源,更大的演化尺度,以及没有标签反馈的演化仍有待进一步探索. 目前框架中的所有视觉观测都由作为主要代理人的VLM直接进行. 下一个有意义的步骤是扩大共演化,以确定主要代理人何时应直接观察或将观察委托给子代理人,以及他们如何能够有效地协调. 由于我们目前只注重视觉模式,将框架扩大至更普遍的全方位模式环境也值得调查。

Do not copy sample identifiers, video or file names, question text, scene facts, predictions, ground-truth intervals, dataset-specific labels or groupings, dataset-specific patterns, or content-type examples into the skill. Express reusable lessons as task-general evidence workflows, tool contracts, validation checks, or guidance for model–tool interactions.
blocks.zh: 利用最新内容来评估衡量尺度和最终结果。 不将样本标识符,视频或文件名称,问题文本,场景事实,预测,地面真实间隔,数据集专用标签或分组,数据集专用模式,或内容类实例复制到技能中. 将可重复使用的经验教训作为任务一般证据工作流程、工具合同、验证检查或模型-工具互动指导。

blocks.en: Keep local tools deterministic and local. They prepare visual evidence and metadata for the VLM, which interprets the evidence and predicts temporal intervals. Do not call external models or APIs, or use audio, speech recognition, or transcripts.
blocks.zh: 保持当地工具的确定性和地方性。 它们为VLM准备视觉证据和元数据,用于解释证据和预测时间间隔. 不要调用外部模型或API,或者使用音频,语音识别,或者笔录.

blocks.en: Record reusable lessons in the appropriate skill files: – references/policy-notes.md : task planning, evidence acquisition, and reasoning strategies. – references/tool-notes.md : tool contracts, failure modes, and usage details. – references/tool-selection.md : selection of local tools and observation modes. Consider the trade-offs between native image and video observation, including static detail, readable text, object identity, and boundary-frame verification with inspect_images .
blocks.zh: 在适当的技能档案中记录可重复使用的经验教训:参考文献/政策说明.md:任务规划、证据获取和推理战略。 - 参考/工具说明.md:工具合同、失败模式和使用细节。 – 参考文献/工具选择. md:选择本地工具和观察模式. 考虑原生图像与视频观察之间的权衡,包括静态细节、可读文本、物体身份以及用检查_图像核查边界框架。

blocks.en: references/policy-notes.md : task planning, evidence acquisition, and reasoning strategies.
blocks.zh: 参考/政策说明:任务规划、证据获取和推理战略。

blocks.en: references/tool-notes.md : tool contracts, failure modes, and usage details.
blocks.zh: 参考文献/工具说明.md:工具合同、故障模式和使用细节。

blocks.en: references/tool-selection.md : selection of local tools and observation modes.
blocks.zh: 参考文献/工具选择.md:选择本地工具和观察模式.

blocks.en: Ground updates in the listed execution trajectories: tool choices, visual readability, temporal coverage, interaction failures, token usage, and repeated patterns where a better reusable tool or tool-selection rule would help.
blocks.zh: 列出的执行轨迹中的地面更新:工具选择,视觉可读性,时间覆盖,互动失败,符号使用,以及重复模式,其中更好的可重复使用的工具或工具选择规则会有所帮助.

blocks.en: Analyze token usage as part of skill quality, not just task score. Prefer updates that improve accuracy while keeping token use stable or lower. Add broad video inspection, longer clips, or extra observation calls only when trajectories support a reusable accuracy benefit that justifies the cost.
blocks.zh: 作为技能质量的一部分分析符号使用,而不仅仅是任务分数. 优先更新,提高准确性,同时保持符号使用稳定或较低。 只有在轨迹支持可重复使用的准确性以证明费用合理的情况下,才增加宽广的视频检查、较长的剪辑或额外观察电话。

blocks.en: Use code synthesis for reusable improvements. Add or improve local media-preparation tools for clipping, frame sampling, resizing, timestamp labeling, compact visual summaries, motion- or scene-aware media preparation, and validation. Merge or delete weak or redundant tools. Store each tool’s code and interface in tools/<tool_name>/tool.py and tools/<tool_name>/tool.json .
blocks.zh: 使用代码合成进行可重复使用的改进. 添加或改进本地媒体准备工具,用于剪辑,帧采样,调整大小,时间戳标签,紧凑的视觉摘要,运动或场景感知媒体准备,以及验证. 合并或删除弱或冗余的工具。 将每个工具的代码和接口存储在工具/<tool_name>/tool.py和工具/<tool_name>/tool.json中.

blocks.en: Consolidate or replace weak guidance. Leave the candidate unchanged if there is no reusable improvement.
blocks.zh: 巩固或取代薄弱的指导。 如果没有可重复使用的改进,候选人保持不变。
